name: Igrici (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Igrici: a crowned blue shield with a lute and a sword, with white mantling and a scroll inscribed IGRICI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Igrici arms with crown, mantling and scroll
